note: s1 wide. Mara holding the key ring over Tomas's open palm in the lantern room; both casts match their sheets, mouths closed, no door.
s1 medium. Mara alone, keys in her hand, three-quarter, mouth closed. Graded to plan1.
s1 close. Tomas is holding the keys correctly, but he has been relocated to the pier and there is a red door on the lighthouse base directly behind his hands — both rules broken in one frame.
s2 wide. Ines at the peg board, tag between two fingers, radio on the desk. The tag carries faint marks but no legible word.

s2 medium. The wooden tag reads 'Shift' in plain letters — readable text in frame, which the series never allows. The scenario itself called it a 'shift tag', which is what put the word in the prompt.
s2 close. Both hands hanging the tag on the peg, harbour office behind, tag blank.
s3 wide. Mara crouched at the bollard with the rope, Tomas a step behind holding the coil, last boat at the steps. Correct.
s3 medium. Mara alone, both hands on the bollard and rope, mouth closed.

s3 close. Tomas should be drawing the rope coil in against his chest; instead he is holding a thin pen-like implement over the rope. His character sheet always carries a notebook and pen and they have leaked into a rope shot.
s4 wide. Tomas alone raising the storm lantern, lighthouse lit above, no door, mouth closed.
s4 medium. Three-quarter, lantern in one hand, keys visible at the pocket — nice continuity from s1. Mouth closed.
s4 close. Mouth is clearly open mid-word, and the raised arm crosses the body so that its shoulder reads on the wrong side. Neither survives being animated.
